detail.longDescription: 📊 The codebase is # openSource under the MIT license, with four architecture tiers and hot-reloadable strict Luau plugins (--plugin-hot), SQLite storage with a memory-mapped draft journal for crash safety, 63 locales with RTL support, and embeddable crates such as session-view. The client is a thin front end to an OpenCode service on 127.0.0.1:4096. Builds ship as macOS dmg, Windows setup, and Linux AppImage, DEB and RPM, each for x64 and arm64.
